title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Eastern Washington Eagles and Utah Utes, originally scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 8:30 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):

This market will resolve to "Utah Utes" if the Utah Utes win the game by 13 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Eastern Washington Eagles". 

The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.

If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Thursday, November 19, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
